propositions: a Jira parent removed in a peer system is never cleared in the local parent_id field because the snapshot omits an absent parent (layer 1) and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None (layer 2)
the differ's guard against spurious clears when a parent key is unresolvable is correct but collapses two distinct cases (unresolvable vs. observed-absent) into one, preventing valid clears
a parent-clear emission requires positive evidence that the peer once carried the parent to avoid data loss when local refs are managed but never pushed to the peer

the same-pass suppression (outbound write suppresses inbound clear in one pass) cannot fire for non-epic parents because the outbound parent emit gate skips them, leaving the guard structurally unreachable in normal cases

the feature must track per-binding peer-parent history via the baseline store so a clear fires only when an observation shift from parent-present to parent-absent is directly measured, not inferred from absence
